notes.title: New Release Date 11/11/24
notes.notes: We are part of the Steam CZ & SK Direct Showcase 2024 and we have moved the release date to 11/11/2024 so you can play the game earlier.

notes.title: We have the final release date - November 29, 2024
notes.notes:
The game is finished and we already have a final release date! Set an alert for November 29 this year or put the game on your wishlist. We are currently releasing a demo for a few days to celebrate the completion of the game and we are also going to have a public Playtest. We'll keep you posted here, on our website and on our Discord.
